cards.imageAlt: 模拟机训练航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What can you see in the simulator training scene shown in this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能从图中的模拟机训练场景中看到什么？

cards.audioText: What are the benefits of simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 模拟机训练有哪些好处？
cards.referenceText: Simulator training allows crews to practise emergencies, rare failures and difficult weather without exposing an aircraft or passengers to the risk. Scenarios can be paused, repeated and debriefed with detailed performance data. A qualified simulator also supports training in crew coordination, procedures and decision-making, although it cannot reproduce every real-world sensation perfectly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 模拟机训练使机组能够练习紧急情况、罕见故障和复杂天气，而不会让真实飞机或旅客承担风险。情景可以暂停、重复，并利用详细的训练表现数据进行讲评。合格的模拟机还支持机组协作、程序和决策训练，不过无法完全再现现实中的每一种感觉。
